name: Example Notes
summary: A tiny self-hosted notes board that demonstrates the MOS external app package contract.

homepage.name: Example Notes
homepage.description: A small notes board used as an external package example.

catalog.description: Example Notes is a deliberately small application whose purpose is to show what a MOS external app package looks like end to end. It keeps a list of short text notes in a named volume, reads its title from a setup field, and protects its reset endpoint with a generated secret.

features.title: Write and keep short notes
features.body: Notes are stored in a named volume and survive restarts and updates.

features.title: Configured at install time
features.body: The board title comes from a setup field; the admin token is generated by MOS and never leaves the server.

privacy.summary: Runs entirely on your own server and makes no outbound connections.
notes: No telemetry, analytics, or upstream accounts.
All data stays in the notes-data volume on your server.

onboarding.title: Using Example Notes
onboarding.summary: Open the app and start writing. The admin token is only needed to erase everything.

sections.title: Getting started
steps: Open the app from your MOS dashboard.
Type a note and submit it.
Reload the page to confirm the note was saved.

sections.title: About the admin token
sections.body: MOS generated a random admin token during install. It is required to erase all notes. You can read it from the app's configuration in Suite Manager.
